requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-001 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The controller input shall be normalized such that a measured concentration of 1.519E-3 kg/kg produces a normalized value of 1.0.
requirements.text: The controller input shall be normalized such that a measured concentration of 1.519E-3 kg/kg produces a normalized value of 1.0.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-002 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The CO2 setpoint presented to the controller shall be 1.0 in normalized concentration units.
requirements.text: The CO2 setpoint presented to the controller shall be 1.0 in normalized concentration units.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-003 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The ventilation controller output shall represent an air-change-rate command in ACH.
requirements.text: The ventilation controller output shall represent an air-change-rate command in ACH.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-004 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The ventilation command shall be limited to 0.2 through 6.0 ACH during automatic operation.
requirements.text: The ventilation command shall be limited to 0.2 through 6.0 ACH during automatic operation.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-005 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The ACH command shall be converted to source mass-flow magnitude using room volume, nominal air density and 3600 s/h.
requirements.text: The ACH command shall be converted to source mass-flow magnitude using room volume, nominal air density and 3600 s/h.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-006 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev B | Requirement Text: The simulation source component shall use negative mass-flow sign for air entering the room because of the source-port sign convention.
requirements.text: The simulation source component shall use negative mass-flow sign for air entering the room because of the source-port sign convention.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-007 | Source / Rev: DR-IAQ-05 | Requirement Text: The controller shall use the absolute 1000 ppm room concentration as its compliance limit.
requirements.text: The controller shall use the absolute 1000 ppm room concentration as its compliance limit.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-008 | Source / Rev: CDS-IAQ-02 Rev A | Requirement Text: The controller proportional gain shall be 4.0 ACH per normalized concentration error.
requirements.text: The controller proportional gain shall be 4.0 ACH per normalized concentration error.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-009 | Source / Rev: CR-IAQ-007 | Requirement Text: The controller proportional gain shall be 6.0 ACH per normalized concentration error with an output bias of 3.5 ACH.
requirements.text: The controller proportional gain shall be 6.0 ACH per normalized concentration error with an output bias of 3.5 ACH.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-CTL-010 | Source / Rev: CR-IAQ-007 | Requirement Text: Integral action shall be disabled in the released hackathon reference run to avoid negative windup during long unoccupied periods.
requirements.text: Integral action shall be disabled in the released hackathon reference run to avoid negative windup during long unoccupied periods.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-SCH-001 | Source / Rev: OCC-SCH-04 | Requirement Text: The controller demonstration shall use the approved weekday occupancy schedule with a maximum of 15 occupants.
requirements.text: The controller demonstration shall use the approved weekday occupancy schedule with a maximum of 15 occupants.

requirements.quote: Req ID: IAQ-SCH-002 | Source / Rev: OCC-SCH-04 | Requirement Text: The number-of-people signal shall be piecewise constant between defined schedule change times.
requirements.text: The number-of-people signal shall be piecewise constant between defined schedule change times.
